name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. Short answer: it only shows bets that are +EV (positive expected value) at Novig's price right now. It does not only show bets that have proven profitable. A bet leaves the list when its edge falls to 0% or less, and the list re-prices every 15 s. But +EV means the odds beat the books' fair price. It doesn't mean that kind of bet has made you money. The star rating covers that: 1 star is +EV but unproven. 2 to 5 stars means that type has beaten Novig's closing line in past data. 0 stars means that type has lost money. Prop Overs and hand-placed props have lost in past data, and totals have won. If you want only the proven ones, set a minimum star rating (3+ is a good start), or turn on Profit-proven only in Settings. I can make that the default for the +EV tab if you want.
